arguments.command:
cat >/app/render.py <<'EOF'
import re, sys
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

x=y=z=0.0; e=0.0; rel_e=True; absxyz=True
obj=None
segs={}  # obj -> list of ((x0,y0),(x1,y1),z)
zs=set()
for line in open('/app/text.gcode'):
    l=line.strip()
    if l.startswith('M486'):
        m=re.match(r'M486 S(-?\d+)',l)
        if m: obj=int(m.group(1)); 
        continue
    if l.startswith(';'): continue
    if l.startswith('G90'): absxyz=True; continue
    if l.startswith('G91'): absxyz=False; continue
    if l.startswith('M82'): rel_e=False; continue
    if l.startswith('M83'): rel_e=True; continue
    if l.startswith('G92'):
        m=re.search(r'E(-?[\d.]+)',l)
        if m: e=float(m.group(1))
        continue
    if re.match(r'G[01](\s|$)',l):
        d={}
        for k in 'XYZEF':
            m=re.search(k+r'(-?[\d.]+)',l)
            if m: d[k]=float(m.group(1))
        nx=d.get('X',x); ny=d.get('Y',y); nz=d.get('Z',z)
        de=0.0
        if 'E' in d:
            de = d['E'] if rel_e else d['E']-e
            e = d['E'] if not rel_e else e
        if de>0 and (nx!=x or ny!=y):
            segs.setdefault(obj,[]).append((x,y,nx,ny,nz))
            zs.add(round(nz,3))
        x,y,z=nx,ny,nz
print({k:len(v) for k,v in segs.items()})
for o,v in segs.items():
    print(o, sorted({round(s[4],2) for s in v}))
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(14,14))
for s in segs.get(0,[]):
    ax.plot([s[0],s[2]],[s[1],s[3]],'-k',lw=1.2)
ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.set_title('object 0 (Embossed text) top view, X right Y up')
plt.savefig('/app/obj0.png',dpi=110)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(14,14))
for s in segs.get(1,[]):
    ax.plot([s[0],s[2]],[s[1],s[3]],'-b',lw=0.4)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
plt.savefig('/app/obj1.png',dpi=110)
EOF

import re, numpy as np, matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg'); import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
exec(open('/app/render.py').read().split('print({k')[0])
P=[]
for s in segs[0]:
    P.append((s[0],s[1],s[4])); P.append((s[2],s[3],s[4]))
P=np.array(P); C=P.mean(0); X=P-C
u,sv,vt=np.linalg.svd(X,full_matrices=False)
print(sv/len(P)**.5, vt)
a=X@vt[0]; b=X@vt[1]
plt.figure(figsize=(24,5))
plt.plot(a,b,'.k',ms=0.5); plt.gca().set_aspect('equal')
plt.savefig('/app/pca.png',dpi=120,bbox_inches='tight')
EOF
